en: A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a gently rising urban street lined with multi‑storey masonry buildings on both sides. On the left stands a large, ornate school‑like building partly obscured by trees behind a brick wall and fence. Several people, including pedestrians and someone with a pram or cart, walk or stand along the unpaved street and sidewalk. Decorative street lamps line the right side. The caption text in red at the top identifies the town, the type of school, and the street name.
